data.whyBook: Every hotel on this itinerary has been personally inspected by our team — we name specific properties, not vague 'similar category' fudge. Daily plans are built by people who have actually done the route, with skip-the-line entry tickets and vetted local meal recommendations. Your trip captain is on WhatsApp 24×7 with the authority to fix problems on the ground — re-route a transfer, change a hotel, coordinate a doctor — without waiting for approval. TBO, MakeMyTrip Partner and Riya supplier access means you get real B2B rates with transparent margins, not aggregator markups.

pricingTiersList.details: 3-star branded hotels on twin-share; standard sightseeing in shared coach (SIC) where available. Best for first-time travellers and group budgets — covers all headline sights at the lowest price point.

4-star centrally-located hotels with daily breakfast; private vehicle for all transfers and sightseeing. Our most-booked tier — better stays, smoother pace, ~30% more than Standard for a noticeable upgrade.

5-star or luxury boutique hotels with upgraded room category; fully private SUV and curated experiences (spa, private dining). For honeymoons, anniversary trips, and travellers who want a slower, premium-feel pace throughout.

faqs.question: What is the starting price for the Singapore City 4N5D package?
faqs.answer: Starting at ₹77,200 per person on twin-sharing (Deluxe tier, land only — all-inclusive of GST). Standard tier from ₹59,400; Premium tier from ₹123,700. Full package with flights from ₹77,200.

faqs.question: When is the best time to book this trip?
faqs.answer: Recommended window: Year round. Book 30-60 days ahead for best hotel and flight rates; peak-season trips (festivals, New Year) often fill up earlier. Outside the recommended window the trip still operates but weather and inclusions can vary.

faqs.question: Are flights included?
faqs.answer: Return economy flights from your selected Indian metro are included in all tiers.

faqs.question: Will you handle the visa for Singapore?
faqs.answer: Yes. Visa type: Yes. We handle the application end-to-end — you provide the documents (we send a checklist), we submit and track. Visa fee and processing are included in the package.

faqs.question: Can I customise the itinerary?
faqs.answer: Yes — every element is customisable. Common changes: hotel category up/down, adding/removing cities, extending by 1-2 days, switching group to private. WhatsApp us your changes; revised quote in 24 hours.

faqs.question: What's the cancellation policy?
faqs.answer: Cancel 30+ days out: 60% refund. Cancel 15-30 days out: 25% refund. Cancel within 15 days or no-show: no refund. Air tickets, visa fees and third-party non-refundables are 100% non-refundable from issuance. Refunds processed in 15-30 working days.

faqs.question: How do I pay?
faqs.answer: 25% on booking, 50% at 30 days before travel, 25% at 15 days before. UPI, NEFT and bank transfer have no extra charge. Cards have 2.5% gateway. International cards (Visa/MasterCard) accepted with applicable forex markup.

faqs.question: Is this trip suitable for solo / family / large group?
faqs.answer: Yes to all. Solo: single-occupancy supplement applies (~35% above twin-share). Family: child rates apply (free under 5, 50% age 5-11, full above 12). Group of 6+: ask for group rates — usually 10-15% better than published price.

faqs.question: What if something goes wrong during the trip?
faqs.answer: Your trip captain is on WhatsApp 24×7 with authority to fix problems — reroute transfers, change hotels on overbooking, coordinate doctor visits, manage flight delays.

faqs.question: Why book with TripFolks vs Wanderon, MMT or other operators?
faqs.answer: TripFolks works directly with TBO, MMT Partner and Riya as a B2B travel operator — real net rates, transparent margins, no aggregator markup. Every hotel is pre-inspected by our team, and the trip captain is a real human on WhatsApp 24×7.
